verdict.rationale: Intuit publishes an official QuickBooks Online MCP server under its own GitHub org, and it is documented on the developer site. It offers 145 tools with full CRUD over 29 entity types and 11 financial reports, sandbox/production environment configuration, and write-safety and tool-category toggles for scoping what an agent may do. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and operate reliably through it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: 145 Total Tools - Complete coverage of QuickBooks Online API
It includes full CRUD operations for 29 entity types and 11 financial reports, giving you comprehensive access to QuickBooks Online functionality.
